groups.name: q
groups.label: Attitude
groups.quantity: Chassis attitude, as a rotation vector

groups.name: speed
groups.label: Speed
groups.quantity: Forward speed: chassis velocity along the chassis x-axis

groups.name: delta
groups.label: Steering proxy
groups.quantity: Mean yaw angle of the two front uprights relative to the chassis

groups.name: upright_rel
groups.label: Upright relative position
groups.quantity: Positions of the four uprights relative to the chassis

attitude_noise: rotation with Gaussian rotation-vector components, composed with the noise-free attitude
band: r of a model without error has the standard deviation (6 N)^-0.5 for the vector groups p, q, v and (2 N d)^-0.5 for a group with d components; the band is 1 +/- 3 standard deviations, N = 275
